svg.title: For zero scalar output this is the finite nilpotent exponential, requiring no density division. If ∥zi∥w ≤1, bound each output-mode coefficient by the sum over switch subsets D of b(D) times the absolute corresponding coefficient of Q i∈D zi. Submultiplicativity bounds total weighted price by P D b(D) ≤c. For zero-scalar zi, the scalar output is f(0, ∅), and singleton coefficients arise only from size-one switch subsets. Switch independence at i makes all Möbius coefficients containing i zero. Exterior silence therefore restricts nonzero coefficients to leaves whose required parent supports lie in the output support, placing their scoped marker pins there. Finite substitution
